title: Basic Square
description: A simple example showing the polygonization of a single unit square.

title: Nested Holes and Islands
description: Correctly identifies nested structures (Island inside a Hole inside a Shell).

title: Incomplete Grid / Dangles
description: Prunes dangles (dead-end lines) and extracts only closed cycles.

title: Touching Polygons
description: Using robust noding, reconstructs adjacent polygons that share boundaries, even if the input lines are not perfectly noded.

title: Self-Intersecting Geometry (Bowtie)
description: Self-intersecting lines are split at intersection points, and valid cycles are extracted.

title: Overlapping Circles
description: Complex, curved inputs (approximated by LineStrings) such as overlapping circles. Intersection regions are correctly identified as separate polygons.

title: Curved Holes
description: A complex polygon with multiple circular holes.
